source: 2016/TSB Vol 16 No 03 - New GM 6L80 Trans Adapter Kit.pdf
title: GM ATF Adapter Kit
lead: MOC has developed a new transmission adapter kit for use on the GM 6L80 transmissions to bypass the internal thermal valve and reduce the service time (Part No. 94916). This kit includes 4 adapters: (1) an adapter to connect to the line pressure port (Part No. 94796); (2) a short 90 degree adapter hose for the tight space around the pressure port (Part No. 94898); (3) an open hose adapter to be inserted into the transmission dipstick tube, for the vehicles that have dipstick tubes (Part No. 95669); and (4) a filler plug to be inserted into the filler plug hole, for vehicles that do not have a dipstick tube (Part No. 94922).
